profile.bgWatchBadgeTitle: Your BG Watch is active. Go to my BG Watch profile.
profile.pushSuccessMessage: We'll notify you on this device.
profile.pushOffMessage: You turned off notifications on this device.
profile.pushInstallHint: Install {{brand}} on your home screen (share → “Add to Home Screen”) to enable notifications.
profile.pushUnsupported: Your browser doesn't support push notifications.
profile.pushDenied: You blocked notifications. Enable them from your browser's settings for this site.
profile.bggConfigureFirst: Set up your BGG username first and save your profile.
profile.bggDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect your BGG account? You'll need to re-enter your password to log plays again.
profile.avatarBadType: Only JPG, PNG or WEBP images are allowed.
profile.avatarTooBig: The image can't be larger than 5 MB.
profile.avatarRemoveConfirm: Remove your avatar? Your initial will show again.
profile.geocodeTooShort: Enter an address of at least 3 characters.
profile.geocodeNotFound: Address not found. Try being more specific or pick a suggestion.
profile.bgWatchBannerTitle: Do you log plays on BoardGameGeek?
profile.bgWatchBannerSub: Enable BG Watch to log all your plays from {{brand}}.
profile.appearanceHint: Choose how you want to see {{brand}}. Your preference is saved on this device.
profile.pushHint: Get a notification on this device when something important happens (a message, a request, a reminder), even when {{brand}} is closed.
profile.avatarHint: Upload a square photo so people recognize you in tables, comments and chats.
profile.avatarColorHint: Until you upload a photo, your initial shows over this color.
profile.displayNamePlaceholder: How you want other users to see you
profile.seguridadHint: Sign out of every device — useful if you lost your phone or used a shared computer. Your session on this device will also end.
profile.logoutAllDevicesConfirm: Sign out of all your devices, including this one? You'll need to log in again everywhere.
profile.logoutAllDevicesError: We couldn't sign out your other sessions. Try again in a few seconds.
profile.bggHint: Connect your BGG account to log, edit and delete plays directly from {{brand}}. Your password is stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM) on our servers and is never sent to the browser.
profile.bggWarning: ⚠️ We use BGG's internal (unofficial) endpoint. If BGG changes its site, this integration may stop working until an update. You can disconnect whenever you want.
profile.bggConfigureUsername: First set up your <1>BGG username</1> above and save your profile.
profile.bggSyncHint: Your history stays up to date automatically when you open BG Watch. Press the button only if you edited old plays on BGG.com and want to force a full reconciliation now.
profile.bggSyncButtonTitle: Full walk of your BGG history. Useful if you edited plays older than the 30 most recent ones.
profile.bggInvalidBox: Your BGG session expired (you probably changed your password on BGG.com). Re-enter your password to reconnect.
profile.ubicacionHint: Start typing and pick an option from the menu, or click directly on the map to mark your location.
profile.ubicacionSearchTitle: Search for the address you typed (if you don't want to use the suggestions)
profile.recordatoriosHint: When you want us to remind you about events you're registered for. Applies only to paid events or those with a confirmed spot.

list.bggConnectedTitle: @{{username}} connected their BGG account — can log plays
list.bgWatchBannerTitle: Do you know BG Watch yet?
list.bgWatchBannerSub: Connect your BoardGameGeek account and keep track of your plays from {{brand}}.
list.bgWatchOnlyTitle: Show only players with BG Watch active
list.emptyFilteredText: We couldn't find anyone like that. Try another name or remove a filter.
list.emptyText: There are no players to show. As soon as the first ones join, they'll appear in this roster.
list.unbanConfirm: Do you want to unban @{{username}}? They'll be able to log in and use the app again.
list.banConfirm: Do you want to ban @{{username}}? They won't be able to log in and will be kicked if they already have an active session.
list.banReasonPlaceholder: For example: repeated spam, inappropriate behavior…
list.deleteConfirm: Do you want to delete @{{username}}? This action can't be undone. The user will be able to register again with the same email and their content (tables, messages, comments) will show as "Deleted user".
